0022600021.text: The Dallas Mavericks, at 3-2 and seventh in the West, host the Houston Rockets in the sixth game of Dallas's season, with the Mavericks fourth in the Southwest, two games back. Houston comes in 5-0, first in the West and the Southwest. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, Sergio de Larrea and Tarik Biberovic, while Houston is without Alperen Sengun, Marcus Smart and Steven Adams. Houston won the teams' only meeting this season 128-110 in Houston on October 21, so the Mavericks trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 series after the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
